13895-patricia.title: Patricia
13895-patricia.creator: Emilia Elliott
13895-patricia.description: A book by Emilia Elliott. To Patricia's pleading, that he was poor and lame and homeless, that Cæsar, the pointer, was the only dog they had now, and he was too old to play much, Miss Kirby had proved adamant. Patricia might give her foundling a good meal, but keep him she _could not_.

19801-the-drummer-s-coat.title: The Drummer S Coat
19801-the-drummer-s-coat.creator: Unknown
19801-the-drummer-s-coat.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. e the great oak woods hang still and solemn above it, till some bold green headland slopes down and shuts it from your sight; and you raise your eyes, and count fresh headlands crossing each other right and left beyond it, fainter and fainter, till at last they end in a little patch of purple heather, which seems to be the end of all things.

3642-the-belgian-twins.title: The Belgian Twins
3642-the-belgian-twins.creator: Lucy Fitch Perkins
3642-the-belgian-twins.description: A book by Lucy Fitch Perkins. It was late in the afternoon of a long summer's day in Belgium. Father Van Hove was still at work in the harvest-field, though the sun hung so low in the west that his shadow, stretching far across the level, green plain, reached almost to the little red-roofed house on the edge of the village which was its home.

arxiv-2102-13050.title: The Fractal Dimension of Product Sets
arxiv-2102-13050.creator: Machiel van Frankenhuijsen, Clayton Williams
arxiv-2102-13050.description: Abstract Using ultraproduct techniques we define a nonstandard Minkowski dimension which exists for all bounded sets and which has the property that dim ( A × B ) = dim ( A ) + dim ( B ) . \dim(A\times B)=\dim(A)+\dim(B). That is, our new dimension is product-summable.

arxiv-2103-02800.title: Hardware Acceleration of Fully Quantized BERT for Efficient Natural Language Processing
arxiv-2103-02800.creator: Zejian Liu 1,2 , Gang Li 1 , Jian Cheng 1,2
arxiv-2103-02800.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Zejian Liu 1,2 , Gang Li 1 , Jian Cheng 1,2. BERT is the most recent Transformer-based model that achieves state-of-the-art performance in various NLP tasks. In this paper, we investigate the hardware acceleration of BERT on FPGA for edge computing. To tackle the issue of huge computational complexity and memory footprint, we propose to fully quantize the BERT (FQ-BERT), including weights, activations, softmax, layer normalization, and all the intermediate results.

arxiv-2111-15548.title: Experimental characterization of rigid scatterer hyperuniform distributions for audible acoustics
arxiv-2111-15548.creator: Elie Chéron, Jean-Philippe Groby, Vincent Pagneux, Simon Félix, Vicent Romero-García
arxiv-2111-15548.description: Abstract Two-dimensional stealthy hyperuniform distributions of rigid scatterers embedded in a waveguide are experimentally characterized the wave transport properties for scalar waves in airborne audible acoustics. The non resonant nature of the scatterers allows us to directly links the these properties to the geometric distribution of points through the structure factor.

arxiv-2204-08583.title: VQGAN-CLIP: Open Domain Image Generation and Editing with Natural Language Guidance
arxiv-2204-08583.creator: Katherine Crowson, Stella Biderman ∗, Daniel Kornis, Dashiell Stander, Eric Hallahan, Louis Castricato, Edward Raff
arxiv-2204-08583.description: Abstract Generating and editing images from open domain text prompts is a challenging task that heretofore has required expensive and specially trained models. We demonstrate a novel methodology for both tasks which is capable of producing images of high visual quality from text prompts of significant semantic complexity without any training by using a multimodal encoder to guide image generations.

arxiv-2209-09031.title: Thermodynamics of 5D Charged Rotating Black Holes: A Counterterms Treatment
arxiv-2209-09031.creator: Adel Awad, Hassan ElSayed
arxiv-2209-09031.description: Abstract We use the counterterms subtraction method to calculate various thermodynamical quantities for charged rotating black holes in five-dimensional minimal gauged supergravity [ 1 ] . Specifically, we analyze certain issues related to the first law and Smarr’s relation in the presence of a conformal anomaly.

arxiv-2302-06964.title: Laser-induced topological spin switching in a 2D van der Waals magnet
arxiv-2302-06964.creator: Maya Khela 1, Maciej Da̧browski 2†, Safe Khan 3, Paul S. Keatley 2, Ivan Verzhbitskiy 4,5, Goki Eda 4,5, Robert J. Hicken 2, Hidekazu Kurebayashi 3,6,7, Elton J. G. Santos 1,8†
arxiv-2302-06964.description: Abstract Two-dimensional (2D) van der Waals (vdW) magnets represent one of the most promising horizons for energy-efficient spintronic applications because their broad range of electronic, magnetic and topological properties [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 ] .

arxiv-2304-00380.title: SN1987A cooling due to Plasmon-Plasmon scattering in the Randall-Sundrum Model
arxiv-2304-00380.description: Abstract The light braneworld radion, stabilized via the Goldberger-Wise mechanism in the Randall-Sundrum model, can be produced copiously inside the supernova core due to plasmon-plasmon annihilations. The radion, thus produced, subsequently decays to a neutrino-antineutrino pair and takes away the energy released in the SN1987A explosion.

arxiv-2306-02256.title: Less is More: Revisiting the Gaussian Mechanism for Differential Privacy
arxiv-2306-02256.creator: Tianxi Ji, Pan Li
arxiv-2306-02256.description: Abstract Differential privacy (DP) via output perturbation has been a de facto standard for releasing query or computation results on sensitive data. Different variants of the classic Gaussian mechanism have been developed to reduce the magnitude of the noise and improve the utility of sanitized query results.

arxiv-2310-19532.title: Scalar field, nucleon structure and relativistic chiral theory for nuclear matter Journal: Eur. Phys. J. A Dedication: Dedicated to the memory of Peter Schuck
arxiv-2310-19532.creator: Guy Chanfray
arxiv-2310-19532.description: Abstract The work that Peter Schuck and I carried out during the nineties in collaboration with the Lyon and Darmstadt theory groups is summarized. I retrace how our theoretical developments combined with experimental results concerning the in-medium modification of the pion-pion interaction allowed a clarification of the chiral status of the sigma meson introduced in relativistic theories of nuclear matter.

arxiv-2402-06435.title: Weak global attractor for the 3 ​ D 3D -Navier-Stokes equations via the globally modified Navier-Stokes equations Thanks: (A. N. Carvalho) Partially supported by FAPESP grants 2020/14075-6 and CNPq 306213/2019-2 Thanks: (P. Marín-Rubio) Partially supported by the Spanish Ministry of Science, Innovat
arxiv-2402-06435.creator: M. C. Bortolan, A. N. Carvalho, P. Marín-Rubio, J. Valero
arxiv-2402-06435.description: Abstract . In this paper we obtain the existence of a weak global attractor for the three-dimensional Navier-Stokes equations, that is, a weakly compact set with an invariance property, that uniformly attracts solutions, with respect to the weak topology, for initial data in bounded sets.

arxiv-2408-06806.title: Unmasking the Uniqueness: A Glimpse into Age-Invariant Face Recognition of Indigenous African Faces
arxiv-2408-06806.creator: Fakunle Ajewole, Joseph Damilola Akinyemi, Khadijat Tope Ladoja, Olufade Falade Williams Onifade
arxiv-2408-06806.description: Abstract The task of recognizing the age-separated faces of an individual, Age-Invariant Face Recognition (AIFR), has received considerable research efforts in Europe, America, and Asia, compared to Africa. Thus, AIFR research efforts have often under-represented/misrepresented the African ethnicity with non-indigenous Africans.

arxiv-2503-03245.title: Less is more? Rewards in RL for Cyber Defence
arxiv-2503-03245.creator: Elizabeth Bates, Chris Hicks, Vasilios Mavroudis
arxiv-2503-03245.description: Abstract The last few years have seen an explosion of interest in autonomous cyber defence agents based on deep reinforcement learning. Such agents are typically trained in a cyber gym environment, also known as a cyber simulator, at least 32 of which have already been built.

arxiv-2505-09353.title: Deterministic Suffix-reading Automata
arxiv-2505-09353.creator: R Keerthan ORCID:0009-0003-8278-0951, B Srivathsan ORCID:0000-0003-2666-0691, R Venkatesh ORCID:0009-0007-7747-4457, Sagar Verma ORCID:0009-0000-9987-4151
arxiv-2505-09353.description: Abstract . We introduce deterministic suffix-reading automata (DSA), a new automaton model over finite words. Transitions in a DSA are labeled with words. From a state, a DSA triggers an outgoing transition on seeing a word ending with the transition’s label.

arxiv-2511-22942.title: Body Management Information Practices on a Female-dominant Platform DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference: International Conference on Human-Engaged Computing (ICHEC 2025); November 21–23, 2025; Singapore ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/2025/11 CCS: Human-centered design CCS: Empirical studies in HCI
arxiv-2511-22942.creator: Na Li, Chuhao Wu, Hongyang Zhou, Huiran Yi, Xuefei Wang, Jie Cai, Xinyi Fu, John Carroll
arxiv-2511-22942.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Na Li, Chuhao Wu, Hongyang Zhou, Huiran Yi, Xuefei Wang, Jie Cai, Xinyi Fu, John Carroll. With growing awareness of long-term health and wellness, everyday body management has become a widespread practice. Social media platforms and health-related applications offer abundant information for those pursuing healthier lifestyles and more positive body images. While prior Human-Computer Interaction research has focused extensively on technology-mediated health interventions, the user-initiated practices of browsing and evaluating body management information remain underexplored.

arxiv-2603-10488.title: Discontinuous Wealth-Gradient Transition Driving Cooperation
arxiv-2603-10488.creator: Hyun Gyu Lee, Hyeong-Chai Jeong, Deok-Sun Lee

europmc-pmc2891813.title: Malaria in Brazil: an overview.
europmc-pmc2891813.creator: Oliveira-Ferreira J, Lacerda MV, Brasil P, Ladislau JL, Tauil PL, Daniel-Ribeiro CT.
europmc-pmc2891813.description: Malaria is still a major public health problem in Brazil, with approximately 306,000 registered cases in 2009, but it is estimated that in the early 1940s, around six million cases of malaria occurred each year. As a result of the fight against the disease, the number of malaria

pmc-10581952.title: Measuring the performance of HIV self‐testing at private pharmacies in Kenya: a cross‐sectional study
pmc-10581952.creator: Katrina F Ortblad, Benn Kwach, Shengruo Zhang, Magdalene Asewe, Patricia Atieno Ongwen, Rachel C Malen, Kendall Harkey, Josephine Odoyo, Paul Gathii, Greshon Rota, Monisha Sharma, Daniel Knight Were, Kenneth Ngure, Victor Omollo, Elizabeth Anne Bukusi
pmc-10581952.description: IntroductionHIV self‐testing (HIVST) has the potential to support daily oral pre‐exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) delivery in private pharmacies, but many national guidelines have not approved HIVST for PrEP dispensing. In Kenya, pharmacy providers are permitted to deliver HIVST, but often do not have the required certification to deliver rapid diagnostic testing (RDT).

pmc-11421282.title: Real-world evidence of direct oral anticoagulants in patients with atrial fibrillation and cancer: A meta-analysis
pmc-11421282.creator: Xiuying Li, Runkai Li, Wengen Zhu, Dexi Wu
pmc-11421282.description: Highlights•DOACs are associated with a reduced risk of stroke or systemic embolism and major bleeding events compared to VKAs in AF patients with cancer.•DOACs are associated with lower rates of intracranial and gastrointestinal bleeding in cancer patients with AF.•Real-world evidence favors DOACs as a favorable treatment option for AF patients with cancer.

pmc-11475878.title: First-Line Use of Daratumumab in Patients with Multiple Myeloma Shows Delayed Neutrophil and Platelet Engraftment after Autologous Stem Cell Transplantation: Results from a Real-Life Single-Center Study
pmc-11475878.creator: Massimo Martino, Mercedes Gori, Gaetana Porto, Giorgia Policastro, Martina Pitea, Annalisa Sgarlata, Ilaria Maria Delfino, Francesca Cogliandro, Anna Scopelliti, Giovanna Utano, Maria Pellicano, Aurora Idato, Iolanda Donatella Vincelli, Violetta Marafioti, Maria Caterina Micò, Giuseppe Lazzaro, Barb
pmc-11475878.description: Simple SummaryDaratumumab (DARA) plus bortezomib, thalidomide, and dexamethasone (D-VTd) represent the standard of induction care in Europe for autologous stem cell transplantation (auto-SCT)-eligible, newly diagnosed multiple myeloma (NDMM) patients. This study aimed to investigate the possible impact of D-VTd induction therapy on hematopoietic engraftment after auto-SCT.

pmc-12658478.title: Awareness of colorectal cancer symptoms and risk factors: a cross-sectional study at the largest tertiary care centre in Sri Lanka
pmc-12658478.creator: D G Wickramasinghe, T Nugaliyadda, Piyumi M Perera, Dharmabandhu N Samarasekera, Dakshitha Wickramasinghe
pmc-12658478.description: AbstractObjectivesTo assess awareness of colorectal cancer (CRC) symptoms and risk factors among adults attending Sri Lanka’s largest tertiary care hospital, and to identify sociodemographic predictors of awareness.DesignDescriptive cross-sectional study.SettingOutpatient clinics at the National Hospital of Sri Lanka (NHSL), the country’s largest tertiary care centre.ParticipantsA total of 506 adults (≥18 years) recruited via convenience sampling.

pmc-12756325.title: Enhancing solar air heater performance using corrugated plates and perforated baffles
pmc-12756325.creator: Badreddine Ayadi, Khalil Hajlaoui, Ali M. Mohsen, As’ad Alizadeh, Mohamed Shaban, Walid Aich, Joy Djuansjah, Farid Sadegh Sheshpoli
pmc-12756325.description: Improving the thermal performance of solar air heaters (SAHs) is essential for maximizing solar energy utilization in sustainable heating systems. This study investigates the influence of corrugated absorber plates combined with perforated baffles on the heat transfer and flow behavior of SAHs.

pmc-12764513.title: The impact of photographic image quantity on early upper gastrointestinal cancer detection during esophagogastroduodenoscopy
pmc-12764513.creator: Chaoyi Shi, Shunhai Zhou, Xuanran Chen, Diyun Shen, GeSang ZhuoMa, Mingzhi Feng, Yan Sun, Jun Zhang
pmc-12764513.description: Esophagogastroduodenoscopy (EGD) serves as a standard screening modality for upper gastrointestinal (GI) tumors, though standardized quality metrics remain undefined. Crucially, there was little direct evidence previously demonstrating the impact of the number of images taken during EGD on the detection rates of early upper gastrointestinal cancer (UGIC).

pmc-13067787.title: 2D Metal‐Organic Frameworks for High‐Performance Solid‐State Electrolytes: A Comprehensive Review
pmc-13067787.creator: Changchun Ai, Yuan Tian, Yilei Shu, Peng Hang, Wentao Li, Yiling Yao, Huijuan Guo, Qun Yi, Hongmei Dai
pmc-13067787.description: Solid‐state electrolytes (SSEs) represent a pivotal pathway for resolving critical battery safety concerns, offering excellent lithium‐ion conductivity, superior chemical compatibility, wide electrochemical stability windows, robust thermal stability, and potential for low‐cost mass production. However, conventional 3D metal‐organic framework (3D MOF)‐based SSEs are often plagued by tortuous ion conduction pathways, poor interfacial contact, and inadequate mechanical properties.

pmc-13126822.title: GCNT3 and ST3GAL1 expression correlates with HER2 status and MUC1/β-catenin/Cyclin D1 axis in breast cancer
pmc-13126822.creator: Rohitesh Gupta, Indresh K Gopalsamy, Aisha Shigna Nadukkandy, Ankit Singh, Charan Raju Tangella, Liza Esther Alexander, Rekha A Nair, Marco Cordani, Lekha Dinesh Kumar
pmc-13126822.description: The status of human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2) is a critical determinant of breast cancer progression and outcome, but the role of glycosylation in modulating HER2-related pathways remains poorly understood. Here, we examined the relationship between HER2 and the glycosyltransferases ST3GAL1 and GCNT3, combining data mining with experimental and clinicopathological validation.

pmc-13335770.title: Mechanically Adaptive Polyimide Interfaces for Stable High‐Voltage NCM–Sulfide All‐Solid‐State Batteries
pmc-13335770.creator: Jiatao Wu, Wenjin Li, Rui Wang, Peng Wang, Kaiyuan Deng, Chengshuai Chang, Chuan Xie, Lei Yao, Guangliang Gary Liu
pmc-13335770.description: The practical implementation of Ni‐rich layered oxide–sulfide all‐solid‐state batteries (ASSBs) is limited by rapid capacity fading from interfacial contact loss and parasitic reactions. Conventional inorganic coatings provide limited mechanical compliance, failing to address these intertwined electrochemical–mechanical degradations. Here, we report a smart responsive cathode–electrolyte interface realized through the stepwise construction of a conformal polyimide (PI) coating on single‐crystal LiNi0.8Co0.1Mn0.1O2 (sNCM).

pmc-13352926.title: Expression differences and clinical significance of PD-L1 in lung cancer patients with different histological types and differentiation degrees
pmc-13352926.creator: Xincheng Zhou, Shuang Ao, Yanan Guo, Jing Jin
pmc-13352926.description: ObjectiveTo investigate the expression differences of PD-L1 in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) patients with different histological types and differentiation degrees.MethodsA retrospective analysis was conducted on the clinical data of 538 NSCLC patients diagnosed at Ningbo Pathological Diagnosis Center (6 small cell lung cancer cases were excluded due to limited sample size).

pmc-13369461.title: Development of an energy consumption map for turning inconel 718 through coupled chip-morphology and material-deformation analysis
pmc-13369461.creator: Muhammad Adnan Khan, Riaz Ahmad, Muhammad Rizwan ul Haq, Syed Husain Imran Jaffery, Danyal Zahid
pmc-13369461.description: Sustainable machining of Inconel 718, a nickel-based superalloy that is highly valuable in aerospace, is faced with the challenge that it has high energy requirements and poor machinability. In this study, a new energy consumption map and combined energy-morphology framework is proposed which draws a correlation between a specific cutting energy (SCE) and the mechanics of chip formation.

pmc-13499207.title: Penetrating potential evaluation of cyclotriphosphazenes target blood-brain barrier via computational toxicology methods
pmc-13499207.creator: Qiyu Yang, Jinming Zhang, Yuxuan Dao, Zhengrui He, Rui Lu, Rummana Jaman, Yaole Wu, Shuqi Liu, Conglin Zhang, Zhibi Zhang, Jiaqi Zhou
pmc-13499207.description: SummaryCyclotriphosphazenes (CTPs), widely used as lithium-ion battery electrolyte additives, are increasingly recognized as environmental contaminants with potential neurotoxicity. We developed an integrated computational framework to evaluate the blood-brain barrier (BBB) penetration potential and neurotoxic mechanisms of CTPs. Six representative CTPs were predicted to penetrate the BBB via passive diffusion and impair BBB function.

pmc-13555312.title: Comorbidities in clinical cohorts of patients with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13555312.creator: Marcus C.H. Leong, Seema Green, Mingkun Guan, Tyson M. Walters, Emma Marshall, Chunbouy Sok, Nicole S.L. Goh, Christopher J. Ryerson, Yet H. Khor
pmc-13555312.description: BackgroundComorbidities can influence treatment decisions and health outcomes in patients with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF). This systematic review and meta-analysis evaluated the types and prevalence of comorbidities, as well as their impact on health outcomes, in clinical cohorts of patients with IPF.
